output.final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and largely reframed the same record more narrowly. That narrower framing is analytically better than a clean-certification claim, but it still does not satisfy the decisive policy condition on the evidence available here: certification may proceed only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by approved mitigation.
